Sept 25 (Reuters) - Wall Street's main stock indexes were ​steady at open ‌on Friday as AI optimism offset worries regarding ​high oil prices ​and rising Treasury yields, ⁠while investors monitored ​chances of an agreement ​to end the Middle East conflict.

The Dow Jones ​Industrial Average [(.DJI), opens new tab](https://www.reuters.com/markets/quote/.DJI) rose ​9.7 points, or 0.02%, at ‌the ⁠open to 51,359.7. The S&P 500 [(.SPX), opens new tab](https://www.reuters.com/markets/quote/.SPX) rose 5.7 points, or ​0.07%, at ​the ⁠open to 7,709.86, while the ​Nasdaq Composite [(.IXIC), opens new tab](https://www.reuters.com/markets/quote/.IXIC) rose ​31.6 ⁠points, or 0.12%, to 26,970.952 at the ⁠opening ​bell.
